description: Debt budget SSOT — compiled at build time via staticRead. See docs/spec/structural_enforcement_architecture.md

import_lint_violations.description: tools/ files importing src/core/ or src/gate/ directly (static regex count)

layer_violations.description: src/core/ files importing gate/ directly (static regex count)

effect_violations.description: measured count of procs in src/core/ lacking an inline {.raises: [...]} pragma in the declaration header or file-scope push raises scope (AST-semantic projection)

nimtry_violations.description: active violations across all nimtry queries over src/ (live count from data/nimtry_live_count.json; data/nimtry_baseline.json is the Historical Cap, not a clean-state target)
